content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for BBAU Junior Research Assistant Recruitment 2026 via email should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience. Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs. Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email. Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification. Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 05-10-2026. Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the BBAU Junior Research Assistant position?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email for the Junior Research Assistant post at BBAU is 05-10-2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for this post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an M.Sc. degree in Physics, Applied Physics, Materials Science, or Nano Science with a First Class in both graduate and postgraduate examinations.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Junior Research Assistant role?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for applicants is 28 years as of 01-04-2026. Age relaxation will be provided as per government norms.

faq.question: Q4. How will candidates be selected for the Junior Research Assistant position?
faq.answer: The selection process for this recruitment will be based on an interview.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Junior Research Assistant post?
faq.answer: Selected candidates will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 25,000/- per month.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for BBAU Junior Research Assistant Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q7. What is the mode of application for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Eligible candidates need to apply by sending their complete application via email.

faq.question: Q8. What is the total number of vacancies available?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy for the post of Junior Research Assistant in this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q9. What is the project tenure for this position?
faq.answer: The project tenure for the Junior Research Assistant position is until 20-11-2027.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification for BBAU Junior Research Assistant Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The official notification PDF can be downloaded from the Important Links section provided in this article.
